utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder on what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly small stuff—anything broken or worn out that’s been sitting around. If you’ve got one, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think I’ve got a wobbly chair and an old lamp in the garage. I’ll bring them by and see if they’re worth fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just keep it on your radar — I’ll circle back with the details and what I need help with.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll keep an eye out. Just let me know when you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to help sort the repair drive, or are you just checking what still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d appreciate help sorting it, if you don’t mind. I’m just trying to see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I can help sort it. What should I start with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I heard about the repair drive — I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — it’s at the community center on Maple Street this Saturday at 10 a.m. If anyone needs directions, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll tell folks to head to the community center on Maple Street this Saturday at 10 a.m. and I’ll send anyone who’s lost your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you bring the blue tarp and a few extension cords? If you can, please also check whether the socket testers are still in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the blue tarp and a few extension cords, and I’ll check the shed for the socket testers too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Leo — could you start by sorting the donated tools and checking what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a missing-items list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you have any priority fixes for the block, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — the only priority I’ve got is the porch light and that loose gate hinge. Keep me posted if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Bo — I’ve got the porch light and gate hinge on the list, and I’ll let you know if I need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the exact pickup time and where we’re meeting first. I just want to make sure the logistics are clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — let’s meet at the community center at 9:00 sharp, and I’ll bring the pickup list. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — 9:00 at the community center works for me. I’ll be there and wait for the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll be around if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out now, so I’ll check with a few folks and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you check and confirm what we actually have, then let me know what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check what we have and confirm what’s still missing, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Gus — thanks for pitching in. I’ll let everyone know you’re bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll swing by with the tools and help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Faye — I was thinking late Saturday morning would work best for most folks. If the school schedule shifts, just let me know and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning sounds good to me. I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking Saturday morning, around 10, so folks can still make the school pickup. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that should work for me. I can help spread the word and keep it around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive today, and what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on. Come by at 3:00, and I’ll have the boxes ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll come by at 3:00. Do you want me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — the repair drive is on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to check in on what still needs attention. If you’ve got any updates, send them my way and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa, I’ll check my list and see what’s still needed for the repair drive. I’ll send you anything missing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. Just send over whatever’s missing when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — low-key works. I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits and pieces second-hand, but I’m happy to help however I can. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I know we’re trying to get folks to pitch in for the broken stuff around the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I can spread the word if you want, just point me to the broken stuff folks should know about.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — mostly just tools, spare parts, and maybe a hand sorting the boxes. If you’ve got anything lying around, bring it by and we’ll figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab a few tools and check my shed for spare parts. I’ll swing by with whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m here and ready to help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mara, thanks for coming by. Let’s start by sorting the tools and checking the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll sort the tools first and then we can go through the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve been hearing about the repair drive—sounds like a great community thing. Want me to spread the word and see who can help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I can bring some tools and check what folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start asking around right away and let you know who’s in. Thanks, Gus!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here now—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for making it, Dane. I just need you to head over to the repair drive at the community lot and check in with the folks at the table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: You got it—I’ll head there now and check in at the table.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out on errands anyway, so I’ll keep an eye out for anything useful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I spot anything useful while I’m out.
